regressions.source: a long string read from a storage mapping into memory (string memory s = map[a][b]) before keccak256(bytes(s)) is compared
regressions.issue: Two storage-to-memory copies of a long string that round 1 printed as copy lines are while loops again, followed by a dead 't = ...' line. The variable holding mem[64] was dropped, so the loop writes to 'mem[s + mem[64]]', whose base is a memory read that is no longer visibly invariant in a loop that writes memory. Same mechanism as c00227.
regressions.rule: Keep a variable that holds mem[64] as the name of that value instead of re-reading mem[64] across memory writes; with an invariant base, 'while s < n: mem[base + s] = stor[k + s/32]' is the copy 'mem[base len ceil32(n)] = stor[k len (n + 31) / 32]'.

regressions.issue: Two reads of mem[64] with no write between (_284, _285), or a read and mem[64] itself, are no longer known equal, so differences that are 0 stay in the text (the total count of '_N - mem[64]' still fell from 33 to 29).
regressions.rule: Reads of mem[64] with no write to word 64 between them are one value: give them one name and fold their difference to 0.

improvements: 8 of 9 rotated zero-init loops (P3) are now single do-whiles; the custom error OverflowDetected prints as 0xa9cb113d instead of a constant times 3600 (P1 6 -> 0); P6 6 -> 0. Returns with two dynamic arrays print two Array(...) values, empty bytes print as '' / Array(len=0, data=''). Custom errors 0xa0febeae, 0xf7cffcd0, 0x900b8288 print with their arguments, unknown09bebd62 and the decimals/isTokenSupported results are decoded, a raw sha3(mem[0], ..) key is resolved. Dead mapping-scratch writes 427 -> 409; unknown0f1e1f56 174 -> 118 lines.
notes: Reviewed function by function (1607-line diff, 17 functions). Calls, logs and storage writes unchanged; one dominated enum check (Panic(33)) removed in unknown5ad6d90a, whose return is now listed word by word (same 320 + ceil32 + ceil32 bytes). The remaining 'while idx - 1' (1262) peels a single '= 96' store, within the new rotation limit.
summary: One medium regression: two storage string copies in unknowna9cec755 are while loops again; plus a few unfolded '_N - mem[64]'. Otherwise improved: P3 rotations, the P1 selector, decoded returns and custom errors.
